summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: @servicetitan/titan-chat-ui@7.1.7 declares a preinstall script (node setup.mjs) that downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts and chmods it, then invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js during npm install. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-tagged file with obfuscator-style variable renaming and a rotating string/numeric constant array (function WV8StW rotates entries), with no readable code paths. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style _0xXXXX identifier renaming and string-property indirection tables. A React chat-UI library has no functional need for a second JavaScript runtime at install time; using an alternate runtime to execute an opaque sibling script evades Node-based install-time review, and the obfuscation of both the loader and the payload hides what the executed code does from any inspector reading the tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
